name: What should I send before asking for a repair estimate?
description: Send clear photos, the damage size, and any leak history so the repair can be scoped accurately.

mainEntity.name: What should I send before asking for a repair estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Photos help a lot, especially for cracks, stains, sagging, holes, or peeling seams. It also helps to know when the damage started, whether there was a leak, and whether the area feels soft, because that changes the repair approach.
